classified: test/factory/*.t.sol — the suites needed for the factory pilot, at the top level of the directory only
scope.unclassified: Everything else under test/, including test/factory/price_feed/, is deliberately not classified yet. An unlisted suite carries no claim in either direction: read its setUp() before quoting a result, and do not treat its absence here as evidence that it is local, that it forks, or that it is unnecessary. Suites are added one area at a time, each with the run that produced its numbers.

deploys: all seven component factories in FusionFactoryStorageLib.FactoryAddresses
mutations: prank as owner to grant DAO_FEE_MANAGER_ROLE and MAINTENANCE_MANAGER_ROLE on the factory it just deployed

suites.proves: The checked-out FusionFactory source composes a complete vault from freshly deployed components, and its access control and validation behave as written.
suites.doesNotProve: Nothing about any deployed factory, its live configuration, or the components a real network holds.

mutations: prank as owner to grant DAO_FEE_MANAGER_ROLE and MAINTENANCE_MANAGER_ROLE

suites.proves: Caller-keyed fee-package selection in the checked-out source: which package a given direct caller resolves to, and how an unset or invalid index is rejected.
suites.doesNotProve: Which fee packages any deployed factory currently holds, or which caller they are keyed to on a live network.

mutations: labelled EOAs via makeAddr; role grants on the freshly created vault's access manager

suites.proves: That a scheduled fuse-manager operation on a vault created by this source can be cancelled, and who may cancel it.
suites.doesNotProve: The delays configured on any deployed vault; this fixture sets its own.

deploys: MockPlasmaVault — a two-function stand-in defined in the test file, not a real PlasmaVault

suites.proves: Wrapper creation, initialization and ownership rules of the wrapper factory itself.
suites.doesNotProve: Any interaction with a real PlasmaVault: the wrapped vault here is a mock exposing only asset() and maxWithdraw().

suites.proves: Whitelist-variant wrapper creation and the access restrictions specific to that variant.
suites.doesNotProve: Behaviour of the plain wrapper variant, or any interaction with a real PlasmaVault.

suites.proves: That the checked-out FusionFactory source applies DAO fee packages correctly when it runs against real mainnet state at the pinned block.
suites.doesNotProve: That the deployed factory at 0xcd05909C… can do this. The fixture deploys its own factory, its own bases and its own component factories, precisely because the deployed ones do not accept the current PlasmaVaultInitData shape. A pass here says nothing about the live deployment.
